name: Castrop-Rauxel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Castrop-Rauxel (a yellow saltire-like cross on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Castrop-Rauxel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Castrop-Rauxel arms — yellow cross on blue
